caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object with a half-oval shape, rendered in shades of brown against a pale, neutral-colored background. The front face of the object is decorated with a carved motif featuring a symmetrical leaf or petal design radiating from a central point, with additional smaller carved shapes around the edges. The carved surface is bordered by a textured rim. Attached to the curved back of the object is a cylindrical protrusion extending horizontally, suggesting that the item may be a handle or stamp. The artist's name, "CHARLOTTE ANGUS," is inscribed in small uppercase letters below and to the right of the object.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
